items.title: The Institutional Flight-to-Quality Rotation Is On So I Buy Alphabet
items.summary: Alphabet has slid nearly 19% in a month while institutions quietly shift toward quality. One investor keeps buying each dip, yet a negative cash flow figure and heavy share-sale capacity could still turn this bet sour.

items.title: Trump Urges Senate to Make Data Centers “Pay for Their Own Electricity.” Power Builders Stand to Gain
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump urged senators on Sunday to pass S. 5653, a permitting bill he says would speed up power plant construction and make data centers pay for their own electricity.

items.title: I’m Betting That The Post-Midterm Flight to Quality Will Kick Microsoft Into Gear
items.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge just posted one of its biggest jumps in decades, and investors are hunting for safe harbors. One tech giant has a backlog, margins, and a spending problem that could decide whether it earns that role.

items.title: Microsoft Borrows at “10 Percentage Points Below CoreWeave.” Now It’s Backing Away From Neoclouds
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft wants fewer neocloud partners and won’t renew one of its cloud contracts with Oracle, CNBC reported on Friday. Citi’s Steven Wieting says Microsoft’s cost of debt is about 10 percentage points below CoreWeave’s.

items.title: A $1 Billion Fund Dumps These 2 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysB&D White Capital Company, a $1. 03 billion fund, sold all of its Microsoft (MSFT:NASDAQ) and Meta Platforms (META:NASDAQ) shares in Q3, its latest 13F filing shows.
